name: Audioscrape
description: Search podcast and meeting transcripts, browse podcasts and episodes, and upload audio for transcription with Audioscrape.

events.d: Get a podcast episode or uploaded recording, with its transcript if needed.
Find podcasts by title and language.
Retrieve episodes from a selected podcast, optionally setting limit and offset.
Search audio transcripts by keyword or meaning and get matching segments.
Upload a hosted audio file into a dataset and queue it for transcription.
